forum.title: Multi Antena design Gerber files from AN6121
tags: ST25 NFC - RFID readers - ST25Rx00 series
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello Mast,

Currently, there is no evaluation board planned because the scope is unique to the application.

Any configuration, such as the number of channels or antenna geometry, targeted for an evaluation board would not satisfy the needs of most users.

The application note *AN6121* demonstrates a proof of concept and guides the user during development.

If you have any questions regarding your project, I am happy to help.

Best regards,

Travis
forum.content_text: I want to try the multi antena design mentioned in AN6121. where can I either download the gerber files for the PCB or order a PCB?
